source: examples/progression.rs with PROG_WALLS_ONLY=1 (same lineages, same days; the wall probe on every stalled day)
probe: on each stalled day, the day-end lineage: the next unslain band boss's counter rows written (unlocks, fire/silence identified, row slots to fit), the whole forge, both; the exits' `depth >= N` pushed to record+1 (push), push+counter; each fork above the record taken the other way (route[...]). beyond = share of the camp panel's sends passing the record (base + paired delta ± pm).
